metadata.name: Scriptify Enhancer Improvements
metadata.description: Defines structured AI refactoring and validation rules for enhancer.controller.js and enhancer-wrapper.cjs to ensure ChatGPT-quality output for POM test generation.
metadata.author: Vishal Singh

tasks: Ensure all model responses are valid JSON (no Markdown or commentary).
Inject structured POM prompt with required JSON keys: basePage, configManager, config, pages[], tests[].
Add few-shot examples for single and multi-page POM generation.
If .cursor/rules exists, merge its content into the prompt context.
Use environment-configurable model and temperature: OPENAI_MODEL, OPENAI_TEMPERATURE.
Limit conversation history to 5 messages and persist under test-cases/.enhancer-history.json.
Auto-create missing folders: test-cases/pages, tests, config, utils, data, test-results/logs.
Normalize all generated file names to snake_case format.
Implement incremental enhancement mode to append new methods to existing page objects.
Before overwriting files, create .backup copies and rollback on validation errors.
Perform Python syntax validation using 'python3 -m py_compile'.
Auto-format files with Black; lint with Flake8.
Optionally perform mypy type checks (non-blocking).
Run pytest --collect-only to validate test discovery.
Perform import validation for each generated file to catch missing dependencies.
Extract base_url dynamically from first 'page.goto()' in raw script.
Insert extracted base_url into test-cases/config/config.json if not already present.
Ensure assertions are placed only in test files, not after each Page Object action.
Add implicit waits in Page Object methods instead of redundant expect() calls.
Maintain consistent imports for BasePage and ConfigManager.
Ensure PEP8 compliance and add Python type hints across generated code.
Generate a JSON summary report of each run under test-results/logs/.
Print a console summary showing created, updated, and failed files.
Extract any detected test data (usernames, passwords) and save to test-cases/data/testdata.json.
Support dryRun mode that performs validation without writing files.
